SPECTRAL FLUID / FROM PRECEDENT TO POSITION

03 / CONCEPT TO DESIGN POSITION

TeleAbsence in practice

PERSONAL STORIES.

SHARED POSSIBILITIES.

Connections with past people, places and selves, made tangible.

01 / MirrorFugue

Recorded performance brings gesture, sound and a physical piano together. Its

meaning changes with the viewer’s relationship to the pianist.

Image from MIT Tangible Media Group

My insight: The same interface can hold very different personal meanings.

Concept synthesis

PERSONAL TRACE

Records, traces and fragments

from a past relationship.

+

EMBODIED ENCOUNTER

Physical and sensory interaction

brings the past into the present.

+

RELATIONSHIP

Meaning emerges through the

person’s unique context.

TeleAbsence is a way of encountering a past relationship through media and objects.

What the cases reveal

02 / musicBottles & ambientPhone

A familiar act — opening or lifting — becomes an entry into

remembered sound.

Specific: The sound and its

personal associations.

Transferable: An intuitive gesture

that opens an encounter.

Photos: NTT ICC; Hiroshi Ishii

03 / ColloGraphy

Brush movement and pressure draw attention to the person behind

the written mark.

Specific: A relationship carried by

handwriting.

Transferable: Process and

gesture can carry meaning beyond

the finished image.

Photo: Cathy Fang. Calligraphy: Kazuko Ishii.

PERSONAL CONTENT

People choose whose records

to include, with permission

and context.

02

ADAPTABLE

INTERACTION

Offer alternative inputs and

sensory outputs; let people

adjust pace and intensity.

03

CONTINUOUS

OWNERSHIP

Support setup, everyday

recall, reflection, transfer

and deletion.

Design for all

begins with

respect for each

one.

An inclusive ambition to test across

abilities and cultures, rather than one

experience prescribed for everyone.
